title: One-step decrease in miss probability
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of degree $D>0$, and let $t,s$ be vertices and $k$ a nonnegative integer. The miss probability from $s$ after $k+1$ steps is at most the miss probability from $s$ after $k$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a finite regular multigraph of degree $D>0$
